mdcw_cw_is_active = {
	has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
}

mdcw_cw_is_bloc_leader = {
	OR = {
		original_tag = USA
		original_tag = SOV
		original_tag = CHI
	}
}

# THIS and PREV belong to two different aligned blocs.
mdcw_cw_opposing_to_prev = {
	check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 }
	check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 }
	NOT = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = PREV.mdcw_cw_alignment } }
}

# THIS and PREV share the same aligned bloc.
mdcw_cw_same_bloc_as_prev = {
	check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 }
	check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = PREV.mdcw_cw_alignment }
}

# Country scope. Our government fits the bloc we are aligned with (Non-Aligned, bloc
# leaders and subjects always fit).
mdcw_cw_fits_own_bloc = {
	OR = {
		check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 }
		mdcw_cw_is_bloc_leader = yes
		is_subject = yes
		AND = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 }
			mdcw_cw_party_fits_west = yes
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 }
			mdcw_cw_party_fits_soviet = yes
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 }
			mdcw_cw_party_fits_beijing = yes
		}
	}
}

mdcw_cw_can_change_alignment = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = mdcw_cw_tt_not_leader
		NOT = { mdcw_cw_is_bloc_leader = yes }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = mdcw_cw_tt_not_subject
		is_subject = no
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = mdcw_cw_tt_not_locked
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_alignment_locked }
			has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_estranged
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Imperia counts this country among the major or minor oil exporters.
mdcw_cw_is_oil_exporter = {
	OR = {
		has_idea = imp_major_oil_exporter
		has_idea = imp_minor_oil_exporter
	}
}
# Imperia ranks the top 15 net oil exporters as major or minor each month.
# Both groups are significant exporters eligible for RP producer policy.
# Saudi Arabia is available immediately in the 1970 start, before Imperia's
# monthly exporter ranking assigns its major-exporter idea.
mdcw_cw_is_major_oil_exporter = {
	OR = {
		has_idea = imp_major_oil_exporter
		has_idea = imp_minor_oil_exporter
		AND = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized original_tag = SAU }
	}
}
# Sender scope, PREV = target from a diplomatic action.
mdcw_cw_can_embargo_prev = {
	NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_targets value = PREV } }
	NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mdcw_cw_oil_exempt_targets value = PREV } }
}

# Membership at the 1970 scenario start; independent of current exporter ranking.

	OR = {
		original_tag = PER

		original_tag = KUW
		original_tag = SAU
		original_tag = VEN
		original_tag = QAT
		original_tag = IND
		original_tag = LBA
		original_tag = UAE
		original_tag = ALG
	}
}

mdcw_cw_can_join_na = {
	mdcw_cw_can_change_alignment = yes
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = mdcw_cw_tt_not_current
		NOT = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
	}
	has_political_power > mdcw_cw_switch_cost_0
}

# Sender scope, PREV = recipient. Recognize an already completed legacy offer.
mdcw_cw_pending_program_is_running = {
	OR = {

			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_size@PREV > 0 }

			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_size@PREV > 0 }
		}

			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p4_size@PREV > 0 }
		}
		AND = {

		AND = {

# Diplomatic action scope: ROOT = sender, THIS = recipient.
mdcw_cw_root_has_pending_assistance = {
	ROOT = {
		check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pend_type@PREV > 0 }
		check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pend_until@PREV > global.num_days }
		NOT = { mdcw_cw_pending_program_is_running = yes }
	}
}

# Receiver scope, PREV sponsor. Direct access controls for live public campaigns.
mdcw_cw_pps_access_available = {
	is_ai = no
	PREV = {
		exists = yes
		check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_party@PREV > 0 }
		check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_end@PREV > global.num_days }
	}
}
